hypotheses.G1_forward_greedy_four_layers_are_suffic: Forward-greedy four-layer replacement reaches held-out Fisher fidelity at least 0.75 on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.G2_some_four_layer_search_is_sufficient: The better of forward and backward greedy four-layer replacements reaches held-out fidelity at least 0.75 on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.G3_six_layers_recover_nearly_all_behavio: The better held-out six-layer replacement reaches fidelity at least 0.90 on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.G4_search_improves_frozen_single_layer_r: At budget four, the better searched subset exceeds the frozen-ranking prefix by at least 0.05 on at least half of corpus-position conditions.
hypotheses.G5_forward_and_backward_find_a_shared_co: Forward and backward four-layer subsets overlap in at least two layers on every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.G6_middle_layers_form_a_recurrent_core: At least two of layers 4--7 occur in every better four-layer subset.
hypotheses.G7_heldout_search_frontiers_are_monotone: The better held-out frontier is nondecreasing over budgets 1, 2, 4, 6, and 8 for every corpus and edit position.
hypotheses.G8_no_single_universal_four_layer_subset: The better four-layer subset is not identical across all nine corpus-position conditions.
